title: 2027 Hardware Engineer Intern

title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern
description: **Description** Do you want to solve business challenges through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on cutting\-edge, scalable services technology in a team environment? Do you like working on industry\-defining projects that move the needle? At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The intense focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our interns write real software and collaborate with a selected group of experienced software development engineers who help interns on projects that matter to our customers. We want to you to feel welcomed, included and valued right from the start. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow. **We Have Two Different Internship Durations Available** * 3 months internship * 6 months internship Please ensure to indicate your availability during the application process. Key job responsibilities * Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring to market innovative products and services. * Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry. * Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed. * Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use. * Work in an agile environment to deliver high quality software. You will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead mission critical projects early in your career. Your design, code, and raw smarts will contribute to solving some of the most complex technical challenges in the areas of distributed systems, data mining, automation, optimisation, scalability, and security – just to name a few. title: AI & Data Graduate Programme FY28
description: ### **Description** Technology is changing the world faster than ever before – and at the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team. Every day around the world, we work with exceptional people, the latest and greatest tech and leading companies across industries. You'll learn, grow and advance in a diverse culture of shared success, where we’ll empower you to bring your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work. **Join us and do extraordinary things.** The question every major organisation is working on right now is the same: how do we get real value from AI, serve our customers better and change how our business operates? That is the work our AI and Data practice does. As a graduate, you will work directly with clients on that question. You will join project teams taking AI from strategy through to delivery, help organisations understand what their data can do, and build the confidence to advise senior stakeholders on decisions that matter. The technical depth you bring will be put to work on real problems from the start. This role is for people who want to understand a business, shape a solution and help make it happen. Here is a taster of the diverse work our AI \& Data analysts do:* Radically reimagine a client process with AI and be at the heart of the delivery * Scale AI solutions for the world's largest companies as an AI engineer * Define the most valuable commercial use cases for a client as an AI strategist * Drive enterprise AI adoption, from frontier AI tools to AI\-native software delivery * Surface insights that executives can act on as a data scientist ### **What We're Looking For** We are looking for graduates who combine strong analytical and technical ability with the confidence to work directly with clients. The role requires both: people who can get into the detail of the latest frontier AI model, and people who can step back and explain what it means to a business audience. We are looking for graduates who are familiar with any number of the following:* Knowledge of how data and AI can be used to solve business problems * Experience with generative AI and agentic AI technologies * Cloud data platform experience/knowledge (AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud Platform) * Data science knowledge with any of Python, SAS, R, Scala, PySpark or other relevant coding language * Knowledge of machine learning modelling techniques * Knowledge of data warehouse tools and database technologies e.g., SQL, ETL, No\-SQL and other big data technologies * Experience in or knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Looker or Power BI Familiarity across all technical areas is not expected. As well as technical ability, you should be able to demonstrate:* Structured thinking \& the ability to break a complex problem into clear components * Genuine curiosity about how organisations operate \& where technology can help * Strong verbal/written communication \& presentation skills * Ability to adapt and learn in a continuously changing environment * Experience in team or leadership roles in extra\-curricular activities * Creativity, initiative, and a growth mindset All candidates will have a minimum 2:1 degree, obtained or predicted.### **What's In It For You?** **Training \& Development** We’ll invest in your development from your first day and ensure you have all the training you need to hit the ground running. We provide a structured and detailed induction programme with our supportive graduate community. You can also look forward to mentorship from some of our most successful leaders. You will have dedicated training, project and research assignments in areas like Data Analysis, Gen AI and Analytics strategy. This training will help you build the all\-round skills needed for success, but your project experience is where your learning will really come to life. The variety of live client work you take on will help you develop skills that stay with you throughout your career, while virtual classrooms and on\-demand learning will keep you close to the latest technologies, industry trends and new ways of working. **Rewards \& Benefits** At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package. You can read up about some of these benefits here.### **Where You'll Work** Accenture is a people first business which thrives on collaboration, knowledge sharing and building strong connections. As a dynamic and constantly evolving business, we love the flexibility of a hybrid working model. However, due to the nature of our work, you may be delivering projects on client sites anywhere in the Ireland and sometimes outside of Ireland. You will be expected to work on client site or in your assigned office for a **minimum of 1\-2 days a week** (but up to 5 depending on business and client requirements). There is an expectation for all graduates to be based within a commutable distance of your assigned office which will be **Dublin**. **Does this appeal to you? If so, we want to hear from you!** *All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as applicable by law. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. Please read Accenture’s* *Recruiting and Hiring Statement* *for more information on how we process your data during the Recruiting and Hiring process.*### **About Accenture** **About Accenture** Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client\-focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end\-to\-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

title: AI Engineer

You will work closely with senior engineers, legal professionals and business stakeholders to turn real\-world requirements into secure and reliable AI\-powered tools. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, test and maintain AI and generative AI applications. * Build solutions using large language models, AI APIs and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Create tools that support document analysis, summarisation, knowledge search and workflow automation. * Integrate AI capabilities with existing systems, databases and document\-management platforms. * Prepare, clean and structure data for use in AI applications. * Develop APIs and backend services, primarily using Python. * Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, reliability and potential bias. * Support proof\-of\-concept projects through to production deployment. * Monitor deployed solutions and troubleshoot technical issues. * Maintain clear technical documentation. * Ensure solutions meet the firm’s requirements for security, confidentiality, data protection and responsible AI use. * Keep up to date with developments in AI, machine learning and legal technology. **Skills and Experience** * 1–3 years’ experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning or a related position. * Strong Python development skills. * Practical experience working with machine learning models, generative AI tools or LLM APIs. * Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and RAG concepts. * Experience developing or integrating REST APIs. * Familiarity with SQL and structured or unstructured data. * Experience using Git and modern software\-development practices. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work with non\-technical stakeholders. * A strong awareness of data privacy, information security and responsible AI principles. **Desirable Experience** * Experience with Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, AWS or another cloud platform. * Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint or document\-management systems. * Familiarity with CI/CD, Docker or cloud deployment. * Experience evaluating and monitoring AI applications. * Previous exposure to the legal, professional\-services or regulated sectors. **Education** A degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline is preferred. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered. **What’s on Offer** * The opportunity to work on practical AI projects within a highly professional environment. * Mentoring and support from experienced technology and innovation specialists. * Exposure to generative AI, legal technology and enterprise\-scale transformation. * Ongoing learning and professional\-development opportunities. * A collaborative, supportive and hybrid working environment. Legal\-sector experience is not essential. The firm is particularly interested in candidates who are curious, technically capable and motivated to build responsible AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

title: Accommodation Assistant

title: BaSE Specialist
description: **Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.** Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill \+ passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level. **Job Description** **Job Summary** The Building and Systems Engineering (BaSE) Specialist supports the protection of UPS assets, facilities, equipment, and grounds. He/She assists with maintaining facility environmental compliance, conveyor system reliability, housekeeping, and facility safety. The BaSE Specialist manages small projects and oversees the work of outside contractors. This position creates and drafts package handling systems. He/She computes cost estimates of design alternatives and documents the design process. The BaSE Specialist is also responsible for supporting the Systems Design Project Engineer in communicating the design options to internal stakeholders. **Job Duties** Supports Conveyor System Maintenance * Assists with determining proper corrective action to be taken with damaged or worn equipment based on the history of breakdowns and discussions with the operations team to determine the most cost\-effective solutions. * Assists with dispatching PE Mechanics to complete necessary conveyor system repairs and Preventative Maintenance Inspections (PMIs), to schedule work so the equipment runs smoothly and efficiently. * Monitors status of repair and PMI updates daily to ensure timely completion of work. * Assists with updating repairs and PMI database by completing PMI checklists so that the equipment is maintained at an optimal level and the facility is efficient. * Assists with conducting facility inspections and identifying operational improvements needed to promote efficiency of package flow and safety. Supports Facility Maintenance and Housekeeping Operations * Assists with overseeing the protection of physical assets, facility and equipment maintenance, and facility housekeeping to ensure a safe, clean, and efficient facility. * Assists with identifying and scheduling necessary repairs and preventative maintenance, using PE mechanics and outside vendors, to maintain the condition of the facility. * Meets with operations regularly and stays abreast of any new projects requiring special equipment to ensure that needed equipment is ordered (e.g., lights, diverters, etc.). * Uses PE Porters, and/or outside service housekeeping vendors to ensure that facility appearance is maintained at an acceptable level for the most reasonable cost. Supervises Outsourcing * Dispatches and oversees the work of outside service housekeeping vendors through physical inspections to ensure quality of work. * Communicates regularly with outside contractors to resolve any problems. * Manages vendors, scheduling, and dispatching for routine maintenance and projects (e.g., paving) in the facility. * Maintains vendor contract compliance and oversees vendor payment to ensure the work is done to specifications and vendors are paid upon completion. * Orders equipment and parts from vendors, oversees payment processes, and maintains parts database to maintain facility spare parts levels and ensure mechanics have the parts needed to complete repairs. Supervises Small PE Projects * Assists with developing the scope of work, and estimates costs using UPS guidelines and industry standards so projects can be evaluated against the district budget and approvals obtained. * On small projects or those with low to medium complexity, submits estimate and alternatives, schedule, drawings, vendor list, and feasibility study to District Real Estate and Facilities Committee (REFCO) for project approval. * Requests funding by completing the Request for Appropriation form (RFA) and sending to REFCO for approval to ensure funds are available. * Creates bid documents and project manuals and sends bid package to approved contractors to obtain project estimates. * Evaluates incoming bids to ensure they meet all specifications and budget. * Interviews contractors to recommend successful vendors to Facilities Engineer. * Inspects projects to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations and adherence to original contract documents. * On small projects, manages the budget by tracking costs against contract terms to ensure that costs stay within district budgetary guidelines. * Manages the design review process of multiple projects to avoid delays in the final construction schedule. * Communicates assigned work status to colleagues to determine potential impact on the department's schedule. * Communicates the status of developing designs to Project Managers to coordinate upcoming and ongoing projects. Assists with Maintaining Compliance * Assists with maintaining environmental compliance in accordance with UPS environmental programs (e.g., Storm Water, Clean Air, Hazardous Materials, etc.) to promote the environment and health and safety of UPS workers and the surrounding community. * Participates in environmental audits (e.g., Damaged Materials Program/Environmental Facility Audits) to maintain compliance with environmental regulations. * Assists with ensuring the facility is up to UPS safety standards by participating in monthly safety committee meetings to stay current on new legislation and share contractor safe practices and new guidelines. title: Business & Technology Consulting Graduate Programme FY28
description: ### **Description** Technology is changing the world faster than ever before – and at the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team. Every day around the world, we work with exceptional people, the latest and greatest tech and leading companies across industries. You'll learn, grow and advance in a diverse culture of shared success, where we’ll empower you to bring your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work. **Join us and do extraordinary things.** Through our Business \& Technology Graduate Programme, you’ll work at the intersection of business, technology and innovation, helping clients solve complex challenges and create lasting value. You’ll explore how organisations can reinvent the way they operate, grow, and serve their customers by combining strategic thinking, data\-driven insight, AI\-powered transformation and practical technology solutions. This streamlined programme brings together opportunities across business and technology consulting into one pathway. Through a single application, we’ll consider your skills, interests and potential, then guide you into the work that best fits you, whether that leans towards business and management consulting, hands\-on technology delivery, or a blend of both. You don’t need to have it all figured out on day one; you need to be curious about where you could go. **What You'll Do** From day one, you’ll work as part of collaborative project teams, building trusted relationships with clients and colleagues while developing your consulting, analytical and technology skills. The work is varied, fast\-paced and practical, and no two projects are the same. You’ll build breadth by working across different technologies, industries and client challenges rather than being boxed into a single specialism. In your first year, you might find yourself:* Supporting the adoption of emerging technologies and helping teams put AI to work on real client problems * Working within a project team to help a client deliver a large\-scale digital transformation programme * Using analytics and data to identify opportunities and shape recommendations for a client * Designing, refining, building, testing \& deploying technology solutions as part of a delivery team * Running business analysis, project management or process improvement to keep delivery on track There are many directions your career can take from here, across areas such as technology strategy and transformation, AI\-powered customer experience, talent \& change management, operating model \& business process design, data and analytics, testing, project and programme management, and cloud. Some of our graduates build broad consulting careers; others develop deep specialist and technical expertise. The programme is designed to give you the exposure to work out which path is yours, and the support to pursue it.### **What We're Looking For** The world of consulting is changing. As AI takes on more of the routine, execution\-based work, the analyst role is shifting from doing the work to directing it, using AI and new technologies to generate outputs, then applying judgement, critical thinking and accountability to validate, refine and deliver work our clients can trust. Technical foundations still matter, but what really sets our best people apart is how they think and how they work. That’s why, more than any specific degree or set of skills, we’re looking for the behaviours that will help you thrive in an AI\-enabled world. You’ll stand out if you:* Take initiative: you’re a self\-starter who spots opportunities to solve problems in better ways, including with AI, rather than waiting to be told * Take ownership: you hold yourself accountable for the quality of what you deliver, and you follow through * Are genuinely curious: you love to learn, test out new ideas \& technologies, pick things up quickly, and keep developing long after the training ends * Think critically: you question, validate and apply judgement rather than taking outputs at face value * Adapt with confidence: you’re comfortable operating in ambiguity and navigating change * Communicate and connect: you can explain your thinking clearly, tell a compelling story with data, and build trust with clients and colleagues * Enjoy variety: you’d rather build breadth across different problems, technologies and industries than stay in one lane We welcome applicants from all academic disciplines, with a minimum 2:1 degree result obtained or predicted. You do not need to be technical, or to have a business background to apply, and we hire brilliant people from arts, business, STEM and everything in between. What matters most is your curiosity, your adaptability, and a genuine interest in how technology, AI and data are changing the way businesses operate. A STEM background can be beneficial for some paths, but it is not a requirement.### **What's In It For You?** **Training \& Development** Your development begins on day one, and it doesn’t stop after your initial training. We’ll invest in you through a structured induction, hands\-on practical training, mentorship from experienced colleagues and leaders, and real project experience, the combination that turns you into a confident, capable Analyst. Depending on your skillset, and the type of work that you will be doing will vary in the training path that you go down. All analysts joining will build the consulting fundamentals, including business analysis, communication, storytelling and stakeholder engagement, alongside practical, current technical skills. For those more on the Technical path, you’ll get grounded in the technologies and delivery methods shaping our clients’ businesses, including Agile, DevOps, cloud, data and, critically, AI. We take AI capability building seriously: all analysts will go through an AI bootcamp, with different pathways developed for different skillsets. We’ll make sure you learn how to use these tools well and apply them with judgement, so your skills stay relevant as the market moves. Alongside formal learning, your project experience is where your skills really come to life. Working with clients and Accenture teams on live challenges, you’ll build capability in areas such as business analysis, data analysis, testing, project management, technology delivery and AI\-enabled change, depending on the projects you support. You’ll also have the opportunity to gain recognised industry certifications across technologies, delivery methodologies and consulting skills as you progress. You won’t do this alone. You’ll join a supportive graduate community, with the structures around you, including people leads, buddies and a strong cohort, to help you settle in and grow. Accenture is a people\-first business that thrives on collaboration, knowledge sharing and building strong connections, and we’ll back you as you broaden your skills, grow your confidence and shape your career in consulting. **Rewards \& Benefits** At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package. You can read up about some of these benefits here.### **Where You'll Work** Accenture is a people first business which thrives on collaboration, knowledge sharing and building strong connections. As a dynamic and constantly evolving business, we love the flexibility of a hybrid working model. However, due to the nature of our work, you may be delivering projects on client sites anywhere in the Ireland and sometimes outside of Ireland. You will be expected to work on client site or in your assigned office for a **minimum of 1\-2 days a week** (but up to 5 depending on business and client requirements). There is an expectation for all graduates to be based within a commutable distance of your assigned office which will be **Dublin**. **Does this appeal to you? If so, we want to hear from you!** *All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as applicable by law. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. Please read Accenture’s* *Recruiting and Hiring Statement* *for more information on how we process your data during the Recruiting and Hiring process.*### **About Accenture** **About Accenture** Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client\-focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end\-to\-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

title: Calibration & Validation Support Technician.
description: MSC provides critical supplies and services to the clinical, life science and pharmaceutical industries in Ireland. Our Service and Calibration teams support laboratory equipment across hospitals, laboratories, pharmaceutical manufacturers and other regulated environments. We are currently recruiting a **Calibration Validation Support Technician** on a fixed\-term basis for approximately 6–9 months. The role will support our in\-house calibration and temperature mapping activities, with a particular focus on the accurate preparation of calibration certificates, mapping reports and associated documentation. This is an entry\-level role and previous calibration or validation experience is **not required** . Full training will be provided. The most important qualities are strong attention to detail, a methodical approach to work and the ability to follow established procedures accurately. The position may particularly suit someone who has recently completed school or college, is between courses or career stages, or is looking for a short\- to medium\-term technical role. MSC is ISO 17025 accredited as a temperature calibration laboratory. Duties and Responsibilities The successful candidate will work within established Standard Operating Procedures and will primarily: * Prepare temperature mapping reports and calibration certificates from completed work. * Review information and records to ensure reports and certificates are complete and accurate. * Carry out pre\- and post\-use checks on temperature mapping and calibration equipment. * Assist with in\-house temperature mapping and calibration activities where required. * Maintain accurate records and documentation relating to calibration and mapping work. * Organise and maintain calibration and mapping equipment within the laboratory. * Enter and review data using Microsoft Office and MSC systems. * Follow established quality procedures and raise any discrepancies or issues for review. * Provide general administrative and technical support to the Calibration Validation team as required. Skills and Attributes **We Are Looking For Someone Who** * Has excellent attention to detail. * Is methodical, organised and comfortable working with repetitive, accuracy\-focused tasks. * Can follow written procedures and instructions carefully. * Is conscientious and reliable. * Has good computer skills, particularly Microsoft Excel and Word. * Is comfortable working independently once trained. * Has good written and verbal communication skills. * Is willing and able to learn new processes quickly. Education and Experience * Leaving Certificate or equivalent is sufficient. * No previous calibration, validation or laboratory experience is required. * Experience in a laboratory, technical, quality, administrative or data\-entry environment would be an advantage but is not essential. * Full training will be provided. **About The Contract** This is a **fixed\-term role of approximately 6–9 months** . MSC is currently developing new software to automate a significant proportion of the manual certificate and report\-generation work carried out within the calibration function. We are therefore recruiting this position on a fixed\-term basis while that development is completed and implemented. The role provides an opportunity to gain experience working within an **ISO 17025\-accredited laboratory** and within the clinical, pharmaceutical and life science sectors.

title: Contracts Specialist
description: Nostra is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) in Ireland, dedicated to delivering advanced IT solutions that enable businesses to build reliable, secure, and scalable IT foundations. With a commitment to continuous improvement, we serve a diverse range of industries, providing exceptional services that empower our clients to focus on their core business goals. As a Contracts Specialist, you will support the end\-to\-end management of customer contracts, licensing, renewals, and billing activities. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, vendors, and customers, you will ensure contract accuracy, maintain data integrity, resolve commercial queries, and help drive efficient processes that support customer satisfaction and recurring revenue growth. Nostra has offices in Dublin (HQ), Galway, Cork and Belfast. This role will be based in Dublin. **Responsibilities:** * Draft, issue, and manage customer contracts, renewal agreements, and related commercial documentation. * Track contract status, follow up on approvals and signatures, and maintain accurate contract records throughout the contract lifecycle. * Identify and escalate any commercial or contractual risks, data discrepancies, or process issues that may impact revenue, customer experience, or operational efficiency. * Act as a key point of contact for Sales, Finance, Operations, and customers on contract and commercial administration matters. * Administer Microsoft CSP subscriptions, renewals, licensing changes, and recurring billing activities ensuring contract data, customer entitlements, and billing information are maintained accurately for invoicing purposes. * Maintain and update contract, licensing, and customer information across business systems to ensure data accuracy and integrity. * Investigate and resolve customer billing queries in collaboration with sales, vendors, and internal stakeholders. * Coordinate with vendors and distribution partners, including managing licensing orders, renewals, pricing updates, and service amendments. * Support customer onboarding, contract changes, service upgrades, and customer offboarding activities, ensuring all contractual and billing requirements are completed accurately. * Produce reports and analysis relating to contracts, recurring revenue, licensing, renewals, and billing activities when required. * Support projects and initiatives focused on automation, process improvement, and operational excellence. **Requirements:** * Experience in contract administration, contract management, or commercial support roles. * Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage high volumes of data accurately. * Experience drafting, issuing, and tracking customer contracts and commercial documentation. * Understanding of contract lifecycle management, including renewals, amendments, terminations, and contract governance. * Knowledge of Microsoft CSP licensing, subscription management, or cloud services billing. * Experience with recurring billing processes and resolving billing queries. * Understanding of recurring revenue models and the ability to identify and investigate billing discrepancies. * Experience with Pax8, Microsoft Partner Centre, or similar vendor management platforms would be an advantage. * Experience working with PSA, ERP, or contract management systems such as Autotask, HaloPSA, Business Central, or similar platforms. * Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build effective relationships across Sales, Finance, Operations, vendors, and customers. * Comfortable managing customer offboarding activities, service cancellations, and vendor coordination. * Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel. **Benefits:** * Generous Professional Development Budget. * Company Pension. * Health Insurance. * Wellness Benefit. * On\-site Gym. * Health \& Fitness Benefit. * Employee Assistance Program. * Company Events. At Nostra we value our people. We are a passionate team committed to doing our best, our values are trust, accountability, expertise, people, integrity, and empathy. These values form a central part of our recruitment process. Nostra is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

title: Customer Assistant -  Jervis St (30-35 hours)
description: **About the role** We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services. But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are. Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work – and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work **Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.** **You will be responsible for** * Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do. * Get to know your customers and serve them with pride. * Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times. * Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition. * Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times. * Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes. * Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines. * Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments. **You will need** * Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers. * Works hard for customers, your team and your department. * You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers. * Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business. * You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written. * You are reliable and a good timekeeper. * You must be smart and tidy at all times. **Whats in it for you?** We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to: * Competitive Salary * Bonus Scheme\* * Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost. * 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life. * Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F\&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2 nd Clubcard available.\* * Life Assurance * Pension Plan\* * Save As You Earn Scheme\* * Paid Family Leave * Bike to Work * Long Service Awards * Commuter Scheme \*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply **About Us** Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”. Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7\.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity. Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190\+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers \- of which almost three\-quarters are small and medium enterprises \- which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1\.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food. We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards. We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life\-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco\-careers.com/accessibility/ **How can I let Tesco know I need additional support?** Please let us know you need additional support by emailing **tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie** This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future. Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities. **The Opportunity** We are currently seeking a Work Placement Geotechnical Engineer to join our specialist Ground Engineering team in Cork, Dublin, or Limerick, Ireland. The team provides geotechnical input to a portfolio of exciting, varied and multidisciplinary projects across Ireland and internationally. Our work spans major infrastructure, energy, water, environmental and development projects, with a strong focus on understanding ground and groundwater conditions and managing ground\-related risks During your work placement at Arup, you will work alongside a team on tasks such as: * Geological, hydrogeological and geotechnical desk studies, site assessments and development of conceptual ground models. * Planning and interpretation of ground investigations, including drilling, trial pitting, rock coring, geological logging, in situ testing and groundwater monitoring. * Geotechnical design for a range of projects, including slope stability analysis, foundation, retaining walls, and ground improvement * Geological and geotechnical assessments supporting infrastructure, environmental and development projects, including earthworks, slopes, excavations and rock engineering. * Preparation of technical reports, factual and interpretative ground investigation reports, hydrogeological assessments and environmental documentation. * Geotechnical input to Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs), Environmental Statements and regulatory submissions. * Assessment of potential impacts of developments on ground conditions, groundwater resources and groundwater\-dependent receptors, including identification of mitigation measures. * Working closely with specialists from other disciplines to develop integrated and sustainable engineering solutions. * Attending project meetings and communicating with colleagues, project partners, contractors, regulators and clients **Is this role right for you?** We're looking for students who are working towards an undergraduate or master's degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnics, or a related discipline. Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes; * Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key. * Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo. * Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working. * Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way. **What we offer you** At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates. **Different people, shared values** Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas \- this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. Candidates have the opportunity to disclose any disability or learning difference they may have on their application form. We will then make any appropriate arrangements for you should you reach a further stage in our recruitment process. The information gathered during the recruitment process is only used to allow for adjustments to be made for the interview and is not considered in any other context of your application.

title: Graduate BIM Engineer
description: **Overview** **Graduate BIM Engineer** John Sisk \& Son are looking for proactive, talented 4D/BIM Graduates in the business in Ireland across the different regions to join our 2027 Early Careers Graduate Programme. **The role** Our structured 27\-month graduate programme is designed to give you hands\-on experience across a wide range of construction projects, helping you build the career you want. If you’ve recently graduated or are about to graduate, with a degree in 4D/BIM Engineering , and you're ready to take charge of your future with a leading building contractor, we could be the perfect fit. This is your opportunity to make an impact and grow with us. **Who We Are** Established in 1859, Sisk is proud to be in its fifth generation of family ownership. Our founding values of care, excellence, and integrity continue to shape everything we do. With a clear vision of Building Excellence, we consistently deliver high\-quality projects that exceed client expectations. Our people are the driving force behind our success, and we’re now looking for the next generation of graduates to help us carry that legacy forward. **A journey to your future** Our Graduate Programme is a carefully designed 27\-month rotational journey that offers up to **three business rotations across the UK, Ireland, and Europe** , giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to shape your career path, fusing technical excellence, commercial acumen, and leadership capabilities. From day one, you'll follow a detailed development plan aligned to a clear timeline, ensuring you gain the experience and competencies required to pursue professional chartership. We’re committed to helping you build a strong technical foundation and excel in your chosen area of specialism. The programme blends structured learning, hands\-on project work, and expert mentoring to deliver both depth and breadth of knowledge. With robust progress tracking, regular feedback, and a dedicated support network, you’ll be empowered to grow with confidence and make a meaningful impact. **What We Are Looking For** * A collaborative team player with fresh ideas, ready to challenge yourself, and us, every step of the way. With a passion for the built environment and a drive to make a difference, you’ll bring curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to technical excellence. * Recently graduated or be on track to graduate with a 4D/BIM Engineering degree, ready to join Sisk’s Early Careers Graduate Programme in September 2027\. Over 27 months, you’ll complete up to three rotations across the business gaining exposure to live projects, commercial operations, and technical delivery. * Geographic mobility is essential \- you’ll be expected to work across the UK, Ireland, and mainland Europe, including at least one rotation outside of your home jurisdiction. The selection process has been designed to ensure that we, as a company, select the right individuals that will thrive with us, but also that you, as a candidate, select the right company to build and shape your career with. In return, you will receive a competitive salary, a focused and structured start to your career and its progression in the construction industry, with excellent support and guidance every step of the way. If your application is successful, you will be required to participate in an online psychometric assessment. The programme will commence in September 2027\.

title: Graduate CSA Engineer - 2026
description: **About Us** Winthrop is a dedicated Data Centre Construction company providing turnkey solutions to our clients, headquartered in Dublin and delivering throughout Europe. Winthrop specialises in providing Turnkey Data Centre Solutions, providing services from design, through to construction across the full range of civil, structural, architectural, mechanical and electrical services as well as commissioning. **Winthrop Graduate Programme:** Building on the success of our comprehensive Graduate Programme introduced in 2022, we offer an opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects across Ireland and Europe. Our programme is uniquely designed to develop skilled professionals with a deep understanding of all phases of large\-scale construction projects, providing graduates with exposure to the complete construction process. **About the Role** We are seeking a motivated **Graduate CSA Engineer** to join our team and gain hands\-on experience in the delivery of civil, structural, and architectural works on major projects. title: Graduate Commercial Sales Trainee
description: · **Industry leading graduate sales opportunity with Edmundson Electrical** · **€32,000 basic salary \+ lucrative profit share scheme** · **No experience needed, fantastic opportunity to start your career** · **12 months rotation through various departments to give you full exposure to the business** · **Great career progression opportunities** **The Company** Edmundson Electrical are the UK's leading distributor of branded electrical equipment to trade and industry, selling over 120,000 product lines and employing over 4000 staff across 400 locations throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland. A fast\-growing company with a long history of training and developing people in both sales and managerial roles, Edmundson are now seeking to continue their success by adding entry level talent into their teams. **The Role** Edmundson Electrical are looking to recruit, train and develop ambitious graduates to be based out of any of their 400 independently run profit centres across the UK and Ireland. As a Graduate Sales Trainee at Edmundson, you will be educated on both the company, their products and the market they sell into. Receiving continuous 'on the job' training, the graduate will also have the opportunity to receive professional sales training to equip them with all the tools and skills needed to flourish in a successful sales career. ***Progression opportunities into External Sales and then potentially Profit Centre Management in the future.*** · **Obtain a comprehensive knowledge of the business as you spend time training within different functions** · **Develop into an external, customer facing sales role after around 12 months** · **Identify and develop new business opportunities from new customers and dormant/lapsed accounts** · **Gain thorough product knowledge to be competent and effective when dealing with customers and promoting the benefits of using Edmundson Electrical as a supplier of choice** · **Chase down leads, influence, negotiate and generate sales over the phone and in person** **As a Graduate Commercial Trainee, the package you will receive is:** · €32,000 basic salary · Eligibility for lucrative company profit share scheme · Incentivised learning (bonus opportunity upon completion of training) · 25 days holiday plus bank holidays · Extensive professional sales training \- fully funded and accredited · Auto\-enrolment into the Company's contributory pension scheme **Requirements for this role:** · Fantastic verbal and written communication Skills · Full, clean driving license · Strong work ethic and a team player who can also work well on their own initiative · This role requires you to work an occasional Saturday morning as the business trades 6 days a week · You have finished studying and are ready for an immediate start! **What you will do: First 6 months** · Learn a lot! · Based in a branch \- you will start your training in a warehouse learning about the products, operating procedures, understanding the market, customers and suppliers. · You will then work your way through various departments including the trade counter to develop the skills needed for long term success. · Around month 3 you will start selling. Calling lapsed/dormant accounts and self\-sourcing new accounts · Begin your industry leading sales training programme through BMS; designed to give you the skill set and structures to be successful and confident in your role. · Develop the imperative skills to further your career in sales **Next 6\-12 months** · Consistently start bringing in sales and revenue · Begin to learn and understand the full sales process · Further develop a relationship with more senior sales colleagues to gain an understanding of the potential next step in your career · Continue to develop and grow in confidence and ability with BMS sales training. **Next 12 months and onwards** · Move out of the Graduate Sales Trainee role · Work towards sales targets · Become an essential part of the external sales team out in the field · Further career development opportunities into management exist for those who can demonstrate success and ability to develop long lasting customer relationships *All applications are going to be managed directly by BMS Performance, market leaders in graduate recruitment.*

title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
description: Location: Timoney Dynamic Solutions Limited, IDA Technology Park, Johnstown, Navan, Co. Meath, C15 PX45 Reporting to: Head of Electromechanical Engineering Introducing Timoney Technology Timoney is a global leader in the design and manufacture of specialist driveline systems for off\-road vehicles. We are experts in Vehicle Dynamics, Independent Suspension, and Axle Systems. Timoney provides complete vehicle design and manufacture solutions across construction, firefighting, vocational, defence, mining, and special\-purpose vehicle markets. Based in Navan Ireland, Timoney has been in business for over 50 years with exports to over forty countries worldwide. Our recent acquisition by Kessler \+ Co, brings enhanced manufacturing capabilities to complement our extensive experience and vehicle knowledge. Due to continued expansion, including exciting electrical and hybrid technology projects, Timoney is now looking hire an Graduate Electrical Engineer to join our team designing next generation off road hybrid electric vehicles. The Role Timoney is seeking an Graduate Electrical Engineer to work as part of our design teams on internal and client projects. We develop all aspects of vehicle suspension, driveline, and powertrain systems. Timoney operates hybrid working policy. The successful candidate will be expected to assist the design team to: * Analyse vehicle performance in MATLAB, Simulink, Adams (or equivalent) and calibrate vehicle control parameters. * Determine vehicle propulsion and power distribution requirements and select appropriate components including inverters, motors, power converters, batteries and engines. * Electrify traditionally mechanical driveline systems including axles, steering and suspension systems. * Design high and low\-voltage circuits based on customer specifications using 3D or schematic modelling software. * Design wiring harnesses for conventional and hybrid axle and driveline systems. * Select electrical components and ensure that their installation and operation conform to standards and customer requirements. * Work on vehicle communication networks including CAN and hardware signalling. * Other tasks as designated by your manager. The Person * A degree in Electrical Engineering (or significant, directly relevant experience) is required. * Experience in developing software through MATLAB, Simulink or C, C\+\+ * Experience using one or more of the major CAD systems (SolidWorks, Visio). * Strong design and problem\-solving skills. * Motivated self\-starter who will also be able to operate in a team environment. * An interest in vehicles and product development. * Strong communicator with the ability to work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement and Finance.

title: Graduate Energy Trading, Shipping and Hedging Specialist
description: **Department:** Forward Trading **Team:** Gas Shipping, Trading \& Hedging **Location:** Dublin (hybrid) **Contract:** Full\-time, permanent **Shift/Hours:** This role could include an element of shift work, which will be reimbursed **Salary:** €37,000\- 41,000 OTE plus benefits — dependent on experience To support continued growth, Yuno is expanding its Gas Shipping, Trading and Hedging team within its Forward Trading department. The team's objective is to maximise commercial opportunities by optimising the trading of wholesale power and gas flows across the UK, the Republic of Ireland and, in time, Northern Ireland. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to help build Yuno's All\-Island gas and power capability from the outset, working closely with senior traders and shaping how the desk operates as it scales. **The Role** This role will support the expansion of Yuno's prompt and forward energy trading activities, identify and develop new commercial business opportunities, and strengthen relationships with supply\-side counterparties to broaden the company's market presence and market coverage. We welcome applications from recent graduates with a strong analytical foundation, as well as candidates who already bring experience in energy markets, trading support or commercial analysis. What matters most is curiosity about gas markets and the ability to work with rigour under time pressure. The role also requires strong Python and SQL skills to build automation, data pipelines and analytical tools, together with Git familiarity, software testing, code review and the evaluation of time\-series and machine\-learning models. **Key Responsibilities:** * Support senior management in developing Yuno's All\-Island Gas Shipping \& Energy Trading capability, enabling the efficient trading of energy and transportation of gas from the NBP to both the IBP and NIBP. * Participate in gas and electricity trading desk operations, optimising prompt and day\-ahead positions and maximising commercial value by reducing exposure to daily transmission and capacity costs through IBP trading and secondary capacity transfers. * Manage the accurate processing of gas nominations and capacity bookings to minimise scheduling charges and prevent capacity overruns. * Prepare, analyse and present monthly performance reports and trading KPIs, providing insights into trading performance, market trends, risk metrics and key commercial impact, and developing tools to improve in\-house forecasts of wholesale commodity movements. * Support senior management in the formulation, implementation and ongoing review of gas trading and hedging strategies, including monitoring fixed\- and variable\-price customer exposures across all Yuno Books to ensure consistency between systems of record and demand assumptions. * Support senior management with gas tariff reviews for supply\-side operations, including analysis of market conditions, costs and commercial impacts. * Execute forward trades in electricity, gas, carbon and environmental certificates in line with the approved trading strategy and appropriate approvals, including flex trades on behalf of commercial customers, while maintaining strong broker and counterparty relationships and ensuring collateral is in place ahead of trading windows. * Analyse the impact of new regulations and support new business opportunities, such as vertical integration and asset acquisitions. * Develop, test and maintain internal systems, data pipelines and automated processes supporting trade reconciliation, trade administration (including trade logging, counterparty confirmations and EMIR/REMIT reporting where applicable) and other desk workflows, ensuring accurate, timely and auditable outputs. **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise:** **Essential** * A degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, engineering, energy, economics, finance, business or a related field), or five years' experience in the energy industry within supply and generation, with a strong interest in energy markets. * Strong working knowledge of Python, SQL and Power BI for data analysis, process automation and development of internal tools. * Practical experience using Git and version\-control workflows. * Experience developing data pipelines and automating repeatable processes, and comfortable working with large volumes of data. * Experience with time\-series modelling and machine\-learning evaluation, including appropriate backtesting and performance metrics. * An understanding of natural gas markets, including supply and demand fundamentals and the role of wholesale gas trading, and of the Irish electricity and gas markets more broadly. * An awareness of the gas supply chain and the commercial and physical journey of natural gas from the NBP to the Island of Ireland. * Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret market data and support commercial decision\-making, along with strong problem\-solving and attention to detail. * Resourceful and proactive self\-starter who enjoys accountability and ownership while working collaboratively within a team. * High level of proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with clear, concise and structured communication skills. * Ability to follow, map and improve processes; adaptable and flexible in the face of changing priorities. **Desirable** * Familiarity with unit, integration and regression testing, together with code review, debugging and technical documentation. * Experience with model monitoring, data\-quality checks and anomaly detection. * Prior exposure to gas or power trading, shipping, capacity management or portfolio optimisation, through internships, placements or professional experience. * Familiarity with industry frameworks such as the GNI Code of Operations and GB UNC. **How to Apply** Please submit your CV and a short cover note outlining your interest in gas markets and relevant technical experience. We review applications on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged. ### ### **Benefits** * **Competitive salary and bonus structure** * **Private Pension Contribution Scheme** with Zurich Life * **Discounted Health Insurance \- Group Scheme** with Laya Healthcare * **Employee Assistance Program** provided by TELUS Health * **Free Online GP Services** via Webdoctor.ie * **Excellent career progression opportunities** in a growing company with strong market presence * **Fast\-paced, friendly team environment** * **Continuous training and development** * **Annual leave that increases with service** * **Exclusive PrepayPower Staff Tariff** * **Modern offices** with excellent facilities in Sandyford * **Active CSR, Wellness, and Social initiatives** plus great social events * **Refer\-a\-Friend Scheme** * **TaxSaver Travel Tickets \& Bike\-to\-Work Scheme** ### **About Yuno Energy** Since entering the Irish market in late 2023, we've been transforming the residential energy sector with a bold mission: to help consumers save energy and money through a data\-driven, app\-first experience. We are redefining how people understand and engage with their energy. Our innovative approach delivers radical transparency and rewards energy efficiency. With just a few taps, customers can gain a clear view of their energy habits—tracking every hour, unit, and cent of their usage. In 2025, together with PrepayPower, we proudly reached over 350,000 customer connections. **Why Work at Yuno Energy** At Yuno Energy, we believe work should be both challenging and rewarding. Ranked among Ireland's Great Places to Work*,* we offer ambitious individuals a dynamic, fast\-paced environment with exciting opportunities for growth. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to treating all employees, customers, and stakeholders with dignity and respect. We value diverse talent and are dedicated to building an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and delivers exceptional services. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Yuno Energy is part of the Yuno Group, alongside PrepayPower and firmus Energy. With almost 600 employees and growing, we are shaping the future of electricity, gas, and broadband in Ireland. Join us and become part of a dynamic, ambitious team that's shaping the future of energy. **Privacy** By applying for this role, you agree to Yuno Energy processing your personal data for recruitment purposes. We handle all applications in line with our Privacy Notice You can view our Careers Privacy Policy \| Ireland's Newest Electricity Provider \- Yuno Energy for more information.

title: Graduate Junior Discretionary Trader
description: **Graduate Junior Discretionary Trader \- Dublin** We are looking for entrepreneurial and highly motivated individuals interested in gaining hands\-on trading experience through our mentorship program. Our structured training program is designed to equip you with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in futures trading. * Cutting\-edge technological infrastructure that sets us apart in the industry. * Access to high\-fidelity data resources and market analysis tools. * A world\-class proprietary electronic trading platform with unique visualization and execution edges. * A global network with co\-located servers at the exchanges, allowing us to analyze, react, and execute faster and with more accuracy than our competition. **The Ideal Candidate:** * Prior experience in a high\-pressured, competitive environment (trading, gaming, poker, athletics, etc.) * Continuous Learning: The financial markets are constantly evolving, successful traders are committed to ongoing education and staying updated with market news and trends * Attention to detail: Traders need to meticulously analyze market data, charts, and trends. This role requires a high level of focus and precision to identify patterns and make informed decisions. * Routine and Discipline: Establishing and sticking to a strict routine is crucial, this includes regular market analysis, setting trading goals, and adhering to risk management strategies. * Perseverance: The ability to persist through losses and setbacks is essential. Traders must continually refine their strategies and learn from their mistakes. * Emotional Control: Managing emotions such as fear, and greed is vital. Traders need to remain calm and composed, even in volatile market conditions * Self\-motivated **:** Possess a competitive personality and a strong drive to succeed. **This role is based in our Dublin office, where the in\-office experience for trader development, education, and mentorship programs is paramount.**

title: Graduate Management Trainee - Drogheda
description: **Overview** We’re Enterprise Mobility. A family\-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long\-term success of our people, our customers and our business. **Why join the Graduate Management Training Programme?** As a Graduate Management Trainee, you'll have the freedom and support to explore your leadership potential \- and the opportunity to become a branch manager in one of our retail operations in as little as two years. title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer
description: Location: Timoney Dynamic Solutions Limited, IDA Technology Park, Johnstown, Navan, Co. Meath, C15 PX45 Reporting to: Engineering Manager Introducing Timoney Timoney is a global leader in the design and manufacture of specialist driveline systems for off\-road vehicles. We are experts in Vehicle Dynamics, Independent Suspension, and Axle Systems. Timoney provides complete vehicle design and manufacture solutions across construction, firefighting, vocational, defence, mining, and special\-purpose vehicle markets. Based in Navan Ireland, Timoney has been in business for over 50 years with exports to over forty countries worldwide. Our recent acquisition by Kessler \+ Co, brings enhanced manufacturing capabilities to complement our extensive experience and vehicle knowledge. Due to continued expansion, Timoney has an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Mechanical Engineer to join our team. The Role Timoney is seeking a Graduate Mechanical Engineer to work as part of our design teams on internal and client projects. We develop all aspects of vehicle suspension, driveline, and powertrain systems. Timoney operates hybrid working policy. The successful candidate will be expected to assist the design team to: * Produce high\-quality design solutions for all types of suspension, driveline, and powertrain systems. * Deliver cost\-effective project designs on time, in a busy, fast\-paced environment. * Maintain quality standards for project 3D models and manufacturing drawings. * Maintain a keen awareness of industry trends and new developments in technology across driveline, suspension \& powertrain systems. * Communicate and present clearly both internally and externally to clients \& suppliers. * Contribute to the ongoing update of the Timoney knowledge database. * Help develop quality standards and processes. The Person * A degree in Mechanical Engineering (or significant, directly relevant experience) is required. * You will be a highly motivated self\-starter who will also be able to operate in a team environment. * Experience in using simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB, / Simulink or equivalent) would be a distinct advantage. * The candidate should have experience using one or more of the major 3D CAD systems (SolidWorks, ProE or CATIA). * Experience with design analysis tools such as ANSYS would be an advantage. * Strong communicator with the ability to work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement and Finance.

If you’ve recently graduated or are about to graduate, with a degree in Planning, and you're ready to take charge of your future with a leading building contractor, we could be the perfect fit. This is your opportunity to make an impact and grow with us. **Who We Are** Established in 1859, Sisk is proud to be in its fifth generation of family ownership. Our founding values of care, excellence, and integrity continue to shape everything we do. With a clear vision of Building Excellence, we consistently deliver high\-quality projects that exceed client expectations. Our people are the driving force behind our success, and we’re now looking for the next generation of graduates to help us carry that legacy forward. **A journey to your future** Our Graduate Programme is a carefully designed 27\-month rotational journey that offers up to three business rotations across the UK, Ireland, and Europe, giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to shape your career path, fusing technical excellence, commercial acumen, and leadership capabilities. The programme blends structured learning, hands\-on project work, and expert mentoring to deliver both depth and breadth of knowledge. Over 27 months, you’ll complete up to three rotations across the business gaining exposure to live projects, commercial operations, and technical delivery. * Geographic mobility is essential \- you’ll be expected to work across the UK, Ireland, and mainland Europe, including at least one rotation outside of your home jurisdiction. The selection process has been designed to ensure that we, as a company, select the right individuals that will thrive with us, but also that you, as a candidate, select the right company to build and shape your career with. title: Network Engineer - Test (Intern)
description: **Company Description** Arista Networks is the leader in software driven networking solutions for today’s largest Data Center (DC), Cloud, Internet/WAN, Service Provider (SP) and Campus environments. The candidate must be able to complete a 6\-month onsite internship working a full\-time schedule. * Candidate must be eligible to work in the Republic of Ireland (no work VISA sponsored)
